About Me

I am a current Master student (Master of Science in Applied Computing programme) at the University of Toronto. My research interests lies broadly in Multi-Modal Language Model, Reinforcement Learning, Agentic MLLMs and Generative AI.

I am currently working as a full-time co-op applied research intern at ModiFace (L’Oréal’s AI Lab) focusing on controllable video generation. I am also working as a part-time research intern in TIGER Lab under the supervision of Prof. Wenhu Chen, working on a project focusing on Agentic-RL based Tool-calling LLMs. Prior to that, I worked as an research intern at Opus AI Research, where I publiched two papers in top conferences.

I am actively seeking research collaborations and research internship opportunities in MLLM Post Training, Multimodality RL and Controllable Image/Video Generation.

🎓 I’m currently looking for a PhD position starting from 2026 fall in Hong Kong or the US. Feel free to contact me regarding any related opportunities. Here is my resume.

Research Interests

  • Multimodality and Generative AI
  • LLM/MLLM Agentic Post Training (Reasoning, RL, Benchmarking)
  • Controllable Image/Video Generation
